decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of five years beginning with the date of this consent.
Condition : 2 - All new internal and external works, including works of making good, shall match the original work in both type, colour and dimensions of materials and in detailed execution.

Condition : 3 - Details of the balusters, newel post and elevation be submitted and agreed in writing by the   Local Planning Authority before the commence of works and the approved details shall be implemented and maintained thereafter.

Condition : 4 - Details of the elevation to show new openings to the breakfast room be submitted and agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the commence of works and the approved details shall be implemented and maintained thereafter.

Condition : 5 - Details of the new door and brick arch to include sections at 1:20 to the kitchen to be submitted and agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the commence of works and the approved details shall be implemented and maintained thereafter.
Condition : 6 - All external joinery shall be of painted timber.
description: Demolition of rear structure and erection of single storey rear extensions, incorporating internal and external alterations to existing building
